new_issues.title: The load test's recording cursor stores mogrify() bytes and then filters them with str membership, raising TypeError.
new_issues.why: _RecordingCursor.execute appends self.mogrify(query, params) and the over-ceiling test filters with "kalshi.trades" in s. In the locked psycopg 3.3.3, ClientCursor.mogrify is declared -> str and returns pgq.query.decode(self._tx.encoding), so the recorded entries are str and the filters work.

new_issues.title: The load tier's prod-URL guard is a per-line scan and does not cover the new test/kalshi_support package.
new_issues.why: test_load_tier_never_references_prod_db_url in test_167_data_status_nfr.py scans test/load/*.py line by line, and that file is not touched in base..head. The new test/kalshi_support/schema.py takes the URL as a parameter and reads no environment variable, and the new load conftest/test do not read the prod URL either, so the diff adds no read the guard misses; the weakness of the guard itself predates the diff.
